snippet.title: Cult Of PiN | Roguelike Pinball
snippet.description:
A frantic, fast-paced Roguelike Deckbuilder Pinball game, this trailer shows what to expect from the upcoming title Cult Of PiN from KennyMakesGames. Flip and nudge your way to complete destruction with over 100 powerful upgrades, smashing 16 rule-bending bumpers with one of 8 unique balls, all across 4 tables. Coming soon to PC, Switch and Xbox. 

Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3144340/Cult_of_PiN?utm_source=yt
